## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] My change preserves the disciplinary breadth of the guide
- [ ] All new external links are reachable and to stable sources (DOIs preferred)
- [ ] No IRB-restricted, FERPA-protected, copyrighted-without-permission, or otherwise sensitive content is included
- [ ] If AI-assisted, I have disclosed it (in the PR description or commit message)
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly in the GitHub preview
- [ ] If this adds a chapter or section, the table of contents in `README.md` is updated
